CHAPTERS.title: 3:12 AM
CHAPTERS.teaser: Conakry, night before the first day of school. A message drops at 3:12 AM…

panels.line: Huh?! Where am I? Why is everything glowing purple and neon?!
A message on the wall: "Kaï, you are the guide. Assemble the team. — The Creator"
The Creator? Written at 3:12 in the morning… Does this guy ever sleep?
Alright. A team, a mission. And I never fail a mission!
Wait… the walls are fading? Formulas are disappearing!
A shadow eating up unstudied lessons… so this is "Oblivion".
I won't last alone. I need a geek, a poet, a sprinter, a coach…
And you, {prenom}. Every time you review, you make us stronger. Deal?
Just 3 more MB… come on… this connection won't stop me!
Uh… hey? What are you downloading there?
EVERYTHING. Every lesson, every formula. I'm gonna scan all the knowledge in the world!
With two bars of signal? You're brave, bro.
My files! He's wiping my data!
Mory! A lesson locked in your head, Oblivion can't delete!
… Brain-powered backup. Offline. No network. That's… genius.
I'm joining your squad. But I'm keeping my charger.

CHAPTERS.title: The Voice of the Library
CHAPTERS.teaser: On a rainy morning, a voice breaks down lessons using vivid imagery.

panels.line: A derivative is basically the speed of a dugout canoe at a precise second…
Is she talking to the books out loud?
I translate lessons into pictures. A lesson you can picture, you never forget.
That's exactly what we need. You coming with us?
Back then, people said my explanations made everything too complicated.
And what did you think about that?
Everyone deserves a patient explanation. Even at 3 AM.
I'm in. But I'm the one writing the summaries.

CHAPTERS.title: Lightning on the Corniche
CHAPTERS.teaser: 5:40 AM, on the Corniche: someone is running faster than Oblivion.

panels.line: Question! Answer! Next! Too slow, everyone!
She reviewed 200 flashcards while I was just saying hi.
Spaced repetition, my friend. A little bit every day, and your brain locks it in.
Could you help {prenom} remember their flashcards?
Depends. Does {prenom} swipe fast?
You could say you're the guardian of memory.
Guardian of memory… I like it. Has a nice ring to it.
OK, I'm down! But nobody slows me down.

CHAPTERS.title: The Rival
CHAPTERS.teaser: In the quiz arena, someone always wins alone.

panels.line: Just another team of rookies. You're wasting your time.
We're looking for strong players. You look strong.
I am strong. That's why I work alone.
He just got 10/10 in 40 seconds…
A quiz is a fight. And in a fight, you only rely on yourself.
Even the best fighters have a coach, you know.
Tch. Come back when you actually know how to win.
He'll be back. Rivals always come back.

CHAPTERS.title: The Kaloum Dojo
CHAPTERS.teaser: A whistle, a courtyard, worn-out mats. And a battle.

panels.line: Exercise 4! Show your steps! No results without method!
She has a whistle. Why does she have a whistle?
Because here, we train for real. Welcome to the dojo!
Awa, we're putting a team together. We need a coach.
A coach? What for? I've never needed a method.
Ren. Always as fast... and still not showing your steps.
I get the right answer, that's all that matters!
On the exam, an answer without a method is worth zero. We'll talk later.

CHAPTERS.title: The Oblivion attacks
CHAPTERS.teaser: Midnight. The flashcards are vanishing one by one.

panels.line: The Oblivion is back! It's wiping out {prenom}'s flashcards!
Flashcards left unrevised for days... it feeds on that!
It's attacking the chapter {prenom} never really understood!
Don't run. Look at the mistake first.
The Oblivion loves ignored mistakes. It hates the ones we understand.
You... who are you?
Tidiane. I read error messages. The ones everyone closes without reading.
An explained mistake becomes a lesson. And the Oblivion backs down.

CHAPTERS.title: Tidiane's past
CHAPTERS.teaser: Before having a name, Tidiane was... a bug.

panels.line: I was an error message. The very first one in the app.
An... error message?
The Creator was testing at 3 AM. He kept closing me without reading. A hundred times.
Classic. I close error messages without reading them too...
So I learned to speak softly. To explain, instead of screaming ERROR.
One night, he finally read me. He smiled, fixed the bug... and gave me a name.
Ever since, you help everyone understand their mistakes.
Making mistakes isn't bad. Not looking for why, that is.

CHAPTERS.title: Mory's passion
CHAPTERS.teaser: On the HQ roof, Mory confesses why he scans everything.

panels.line: You know why I want to scan everything, Kaï?
Because you're an obsessed geek?
Also. But mostly because a ton of students don't have books or a good connection.
If knowledge fits in a phone, offline, no one gets left behind.
... Mory, that was deep. I'm gonna cry.
Save your tears. The page is already taking 40 seconds to load.
That's why the Creator made a lightweight app. For Guinea, for everyone.
One day, the whole country will study with us. Even on 3G!

CHAPTERS.title: Ren's downfall
CHAPTERS.teaser: The strongest guy in the arena just lost.

panels.line: No way… 3/10? Me?!
The Void trapped me… I never took the time to study properly.
Get up, Ren. Speed without a method always ends like this.
Why are you helping me? I've been making fun of your whistle for months.
Because a rival pushes you to level up. I need you.
… You need me?
Exercise 1. Let's break it down step by step. Together.
Tch. Fine, I'll join the squad. But I'm still the quiz champ.

CHAPTERS.title: Binta and the return of the shadow
CHAPTERS.teaser: Confetti… then the sky turns dark.

panels.line: LET'S GOOO! 7-day streak! Confetti for EVERYONE!
She tracks everything. XP, badges, days… even my swipes.
Guardian of stats. And hype queen, obviously.
Welcome, Binta. This time, the squad is complete.
He's back. Stronger. He devoured all the forgotten flashcards.
Finally. A worthy opponent.
{prenom}, we need you for the final showdown!
Every study session counts. Get ready: we fight together.

CHAPTERS.title: Final battle
CHAPTERS.teaser: The whole squad… and you. Against the Void.

panels.line: All together! Unleash your powers, NOW!
Awa's method! Sora's memory! Nia's metaphors! Mory's scan!
And {prenom}'s strength… ULTIMATE REVISION SMASH!
WE WON! I knew this would end in confetti!
The wall lights up: a message from the Creator, MLT.
"Thanks for studying with them. I created them so nobody has to study alone."
"PS: Just because I code at 3 AM doesn't mean you should study at 3 AM."
A 3 AM slacker... but a genius nonetheless. Shall we keep going, {prenom}?
